svg.title: Day 27 · slime Training System Architecture
svg.desc: A Chinese architecture map of slime showing the exact control hierarchy from train.py or train_async.py to the sibling RolloutManager and RayTrainGroup controllers, their use of Ray, SGLang and Megatron, the online reinforcement-learning data loop, four flow types, state ownership, observable evidence and failure triage.
svg.text: Day 27 · slime Training System：职责、对象、状态与证据
slime 写 RL 工作流；Ray 调度 actor/GPU；SGLang 生成；Megatron 学习；PyTorch/NCCL/CUDA 执行。框架名不是同一层的互斥替代品。
CONCEPT MAP · CPU SOURCE STUDY · NO NEW GPU CLAIM
1 · 实际控制层级：两个 sibling controller，不等于同时并行
顶层 entry 决定 generate/train/sync 的顺序或重叠；RolloutManager 管 rollout 侧，RayTrainGroup 管 learner 侧；Ray 是两侧共同使用的执行底座。
train.py：同步执行 generate → train → update weights
train_async.py：通过 ObjectRef / ray.get 时机让 rollout 与 learner 有界重叠

text.tspan: entry 才是两条 controller 分支的共同上层
内部状态：DataSource · rollout/eval callbacks · rollout_id · engine lock · health monitors
生命周期：start/attach SGLang Router → ServerGroups → Engines；on/offload、recover、check weights
generate()：取 Sample → rollout/reward → debug evidence → convert train data → split by DP
slime 本地 Python manager，不是 Ray Core 自带组件
创建并持有 MegatronTrainRayActor × world_size（每个 distributed rank 一个 actor handle）
调用 async_train · save_model · update_weights · clear/offload/release

svg.text: sync entry 顺序执行；async entry 才可能重叠
2 · Online RL 逻辑闭环：对象沿箭头移动，版本沿闭环传播
上排生成数据，下排训练并回传权重；RolloutManager 和 RayTrainGroup 是 sibling controllers，entry 的等待策略才决定同步或异步。

text.tspan: external SGLang can live outside this Ray cluster

svg.text: 训练层决定“算什么/何时通信”，runtime 层决定“如何执行”；NaN 应先沿 loss inputs 定位，只有首次异常落在算子边界才升级 device compute。
3 · Node ledger：process、对象、状态、证据和首要故障
“状态”写节点真正维护的内容；“证据”写下游或操作者能够独立观察、交叉核验的事实。

text.tspan: controllers use Ray, not vice versa
Ray hosts both sides' remote actors
wrong wait order · import drift · pending PG
queue depth · ids · version distribution · dumps
mixed versions · lost group · schema mismatch
SGLang: Ray actors or external servers
raw verifier result · latency · reward ledger
infra error as reward · nondeterminism · drift
loss parts · grad norm · step · weight hash
partial sync · stale worker · cache/in-flight race
evidence is not the live state itself

svg.text: 4 · 首轮诊断：先找“首次不一致”的层，不从最底层猜

text.tspan: ModuleNotFound → recipe/environment：actor 内同环境 import
placement pending → Ray control plane：request vs available resources
actor alive 只证明进程存在，不证明模型 ready
先查 learner：current/old logprob → ratio/KL → mask → loss
再查 grad/optimizer；只有首次异常在 kernel 边界才查 device
证据：loss 分项、finite checks、grad norm、optimizer step
对齐 learner publish hash → worker load hash → ACK → request time
严格 on-policy 下重跑；不能用 null 破坏 GRPO group

svg.text: Evidence boundary · Day 26 pinned slime v0.3.1 source paths passed static audit；supplied runtime failed S0, so model load / rollout / optimizer / weight sync remain RUNTIME UNKNOWN for that run.
Primary references: THUDM/slime README & usage docs · slime architecture blog · local Day 26 runtime config/static audit.
